name: DWH Website Declaration Profile

owns.siteHierarchy: public hierarchy entities, parent/child relations, path declarations and ordering
owns.content: content identity, declarative content data and content placement/binding relations
owns.projectors: projector identity, declarative projector configuration, variant relations and projector placement
owns.rendererBindings: binding from projected presentation identity to executable renderer identity/path
owns.routes: public route declarations and route-to-page/resource relations
owns.composition: page/section graph, ordering and placement relations
owns.actions: action identity, label/presentation metadata, domain action reference and placement relations

projectionRule: WebEngine receives deterministic projections of these declarations and does not become their canonical authority
relationRules: relation identity is defined by a canonical contract rather than inferred from field names or physical layout
ordering is declarative relation/projection data and does not change entity identity
a missing required relation fails visibly rather than invoking heuristic fallback
runtime state created by WebEngine, WebGUI or S3D does not mutate canonical declaration authority unless an explicit governed write path is invoked
